strings.htp_math_pyramid_b_1: Math Pyramid is a fun number-building game where every number helps create the number above it!
strings.htp_math_pyramid_b_2: You will see a pyramid made of rows of boxes. Depending on the level, the pyramid can have 2 to 6 layers.
strings.htp_math_pyramid_b_3: Look at the two numbers at the bottom.
strings.htp_math_pyramid_b_5: Their sum goes in the box above.
strings.htp_math_pyramid_b_6: Fill in all the empty boxes by adding the numbers below.
strings.htp_math_pyramid_b_7: Complete the puzzle when all boxes are filled correctly from bottom to top.
strings.htp_math_pyramid_b_9: Kids repeatedly add small and medium numbers — building fluency.
strings.htp_math_pyramid_b_11: Kids see how lower numbers create upper numbers.
strings.htp_math_pyramid_b_13: Each correct box gives instant feedback — encouraging independence.
strings.htp_math_pyramid_b_15: Kids stay focused to complete all layers accurately.
strings.htp_math_pyramid_b_17: Children understand how numbers combine and grow — essential for algebra.
strings.htp_math_pyramid_b_18: Children see how two values combine to create a new value
strings.htp_math_pyramid_b_19: They practice addition & subtraction patterns, not random sums
strings.htp_math_pyramid_b_20: They understand hierarchy — base numbers build higher numbers
strings.htp_math_pyramid_b_21: The pyramid format helps visualize how parts create a whole
strings.htp_sudoku_b_1: Sudoku is a fun number puzzle where you fill in the empty boxes using your thinking skills!
strings.htp_sudoku_b_5: Each row must have all different numbers.
strings.htp_sudoku_b_6: Each column must have all different numbers.
strings.htp_sudoku_b_7: Each small block must also have all different numbers.
strings.htp_sudoku_b_8: Tap an empty box and choose a number that does not repeat.
strings.htp_sudoku_b_9: You win when the entire grid follows Sudoku rules!
strings.htp_sudoku_b_11: Kids analyze clues and figure out where numbers can or cannot go.
strings.htp_sudoku_b_13: They test possibilities and choose the correct one based on rules.
strings.htp_sudoku_b_15: Completing a Sudoku needs calm thinking — great for attention span development.
strings.htp_sudoku_b_17: Children begin to notice patterns across rows and grids.
strings.htp_sudoku_b_19: Solving tough puzzles builds confidence and perseverance.
strings.htp_sudoku_b_23: Develop deductive reasoning (If this number cannot go here, it must go there!)
strings.htp_target_number_b_1: In this game, you become a little math explorer!
strings.htp_target_number_b_2: You get a target number and a set of smaller numbers.
strings.htp_target_number_b_3: Your mission is to use math operations to reach the target number.
strings.htp_target_number_b_4: You will see a target number (for example: 25).
strings.htp_target_number_b_5: You will also see some numbers you can use, like: 5, 5, 6.
strings.htp_target_number_b_6: You can use math operations such as:
strings.htp_target_number_b_7: Try different combinations until you reach the target.
strings.htp_target_number_b_8: When you hit the target correctly — you win!
strings.htp_target_number_b_10: Kids practice all four operations in a hands-on way.
strings.htp_target_number_b_12: Kids see there are multiple ways to reach an answer.
strings.htp_target_number_b_16: Children see how operations change values.
strings.htp_target_number_b_18: Reaching the target gives a sense of achievement.
strings.htp_target_number_b_20: Practicing mental math in real scenarios.
strings.htp_target_number_b_22: Breaking down a goal into smaller steps.
strings.htp_target_number_b_23: Developing strategic reasoning like real word problems.
strings.htp_target_number_b_26: “How do I reach the target logically?”
strings.htp_number_path_b_1: Arrive with the wrong number and the goal bounces you back — rethink your route!
